root_cause:
CONSOLE_HTML_FORMAT in rich/_export_format.py emitted `<!DOCTYPE html>
<head>...</head>
<html>
<body>`, i.e. the <html> open tag came after </head> instead of wrapping <head>, producing invalid HTML from Console.export_html/save_html (issue #3021).
best_solution:
In rich/_export_format.py move the single `<html>` line from after `</head>` to directly after `<!DOCTYPE html>`, so the template reads `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>...</head>
<body>...</body>
</html>`. Touch nothing else: keep the leading `"""\` line continuation (the output must still start exactly with `<!DOCTYPE html>`), keep every `{{`/`}}` escape (the templates are str.format strings), and leave CONSOLE_SVG_FORMAT alone. The pre-commit config bump in the PR is incidental tooling and is not needed. Reasoning from the statement: 'fix the HTML export template' + issue #3021 ('<html> should surround <head>') points to the one template constant; grep for `<!DOCTYPE html>` finds it.
hidden_test_demands:
tests/test_console.py::test_export_html, test_export_html_inline, test_save_html compare the full exported string byte-for-byte: it must begin with '<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">' and have '</head>
<body>' (no <html> between them). Existing test_export_svg, test_export_svg_specified_unique_id, test_save_svg must keep passing, so the SVG template's doubled braces must be untouched.
locating_signals: Statement says only 'HTML export template' and '#3021' (issue text not included in the statement). Grepping for 'DOCTYPE' or 'export_html' leads to rich/_export_format.py CONSOLE_HTML_FORMAT; the constant is not named. The mention of pre-commit config is a distractor that lured agents into editing .pre-commit-config.yaml.
our_outcome_summary: All four configs failed. v4 (101s, 40 calls) never moved <html>; it rewrote `"""\\\n<!DOCTYPE` as `"""<!DOCTYPE` (harmless) but 'de-escaped' CONSOLE_SVG_FORMAT `{{`->`{`, breaking str.format (KeyError: '\n        font-family' in 3 SVG tests), plus rewrote .pre-commit-config.yaml. v6 (173s) did move <html> correctly but dropped the `\` continuation so output starts with '\n<!DOCTYPE html>' (3 HTML tests fail on exact string) and made the same SVG `{{`->`{` damage (3 SVG tests fail) and bumped pre-commit revs. v7 (269s, 65 calls) and v8 (366s, 34 calls) produced empty patches despite a 2-line fix.
generalizable_lesson: Make the minimal edit the statement describes and do not 'clean up' adjacent code you do not understand: in Python template constants, `{{`/`}}` are str.format escapes and a trailing `\` after an opening triple quote suppresses the leading newline; changing either silently alters output that tests compare byte-for-byte. Ignore incidental tooling changes a PR description mentions (pre-commit, CI config) unless the statement makes them the goal. After editing a template, render it once (call the public export function) and diff the output against the pre-edit output to confirm only the intended bytes changed; also run the existing tests for sibling templates in the same file.
